auth.title: Start NIS2 compliance
auth.description: Create an account or sign in.
auth.switchToLogin: Already have an account? Sign in
auth.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
auth.errorConsentRequired: Please accept the Terms and Privacy Policy to continue.
auth.errorEmailNotVerified: Please verify your email first. Check your inbox for the code we sent.
auth.consentLabel: I accept the <terms>Terms of Service</terms> and acknowledge the <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.
auth.verifyTitle: One last step: verify your email
auth.verifyDescription: We sent a 6-digit code to {email}. One-time check that you own this address. After this, you sign in with your password only — no more codes.
auth.verifyResent: New code sent. Check your inbox.
auth.verifyResendCooldown: Wait a few minutes before requesting another code.
auth.verifyErrorInvalidCode: Invalid or expired code. Try again or request a new one.

forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.description: Enter your email address. We will send you a 6-digit code you can use to set a new password.
forgotPassword.codeSentInfo: If an account with this address exists, a code is on its way. Enter the code and a new password below.
forgotPassword.resetDescription: Enter the code from the email sent to {email} and choose a new password.
forgotPassword.errorResetFailed: Invalid or expired code. Please request a new one.
